hotel_room_night.place: Luxury Paris hotel room interior with a large window onto the city
hotel_room_night.desc: Wood-panelled walls, red curtains with gold tassels and lace sheers framing a tall window; outside: night rooftops, lit windows and an illuminated Eiffel Tower (right of window, x ~68%). Warm wall sconces at left (x ~17%) and right (x ~94%). Small round side table at far left (x 0-12%, y 48-72%). Wide empty wooden floor from y ~68% to bottom across the full width; centre is clean for one or two actors; a prop (suitcase, table) fits left-centre or right-centre.

paris_dusk.place: Paris cobbled plaza/terrace with balustrade, Eiffel Tower in distance
paris_dusk.desc: Orange-pink sunset sky; Eiffel Tower right-centre (x 70-78%) beyond trees and a stone balustrade at y ~58%. Building with lamp post, awning and flower box at left (x 0-20%); lamp post and building with ivy urn at right (x 87-100%). Cobblestone floor from y ~62% to bottom is fully open; centre x 25-80% clear for actors; second actor or prop fits left-centre or right-centre. Keep feet below y ~68%.

paris_grey.place: Paris cobbled plaza in rain, shuttered shops either side, Eiffel Tower far away
paris_grey.desc: Overcast grey-blue sky, wet reflective cobbles from y ~63% down, closed roller shutters at left (x 0-20%) and right (x 82-100%). Lamp posts at x ~22% and ~80%. Small Eiffel Tower in mist at x ~72%. Open centre floor x 25-75% for actors; mood: bad news, failure, loneliness. Prop fits left or right of centre.

paris_night.place: Paris street in front of a grand hotel with arched double door and glass canopy
paris_night.desc: Dark blue sky; large lit stone facade with double doors and canopy at centre-right (x 65-80%, door y 45-62%), warm lamp posts at left (x ~11%) and right (x ~92%), small Eiffel Tower at left-centre (x ~25%), tree and awning top-left. Wet cobbles from y ~63% to bottom fully open. Good for arrival/leaving the hotel; actor can stand before the door (centre-right) or in open left-centre foreground.

paris_tower_grey.place: Large open sandy esplanade right at the Eiffel Tower, scaffolding visible
paris_tower_grey.desc: Cloudy grey sky; Eiffel Tower base and first platform fill the right third (x 68-100%), scaffolding at x ~62%, Invalides dome at x ~36%. Balustrades at far left and right, lamp post and hedge top-left (x ~6%), flower urn at right. Huge empty tan ground from y ~66% to bottom, full width. Ideal for scam scenes at the tower: actors left or centre, tower behind right. Keep right-hand actor under x ~85%.

paris_tower_night.place: Open plaza near the Eiffel Tower with park trees and lamps
paris_tower_night.desc: Starry navy sky; Eiffel Tower lit gold at x 74-90%; row of small lamps along tree line at y ~55%; large oak top-left (x 0-33%); tall lamp post far right (x 93-100%); flower planter bottom-left (x 0-14%, y 80-100%). Sandy ground y 62-100% open, centre x 15-85% clear. Good for secret/shady meeting scenes; keep actors off the bottom-left planter and the right lamp post.
